limitations: This is a separate unselected geometry trial; all original V11 shortened-bolt evidence is preserved and not replaced.

The only new structural axes are the two source-screened upper-rear half-inch locations; each uses a rigid translation of the exact current same-side five-part G0340956/2573/15025 stack with no spacer.
Four fresh 14.2875-mm bore cuts are modeled in the current side/leg receiver BRePs. Their stock outlines, basis, datum, and end planes are unchanged.

The strength screen's 4D edge margin is about 0.145 mm and its optional 2-mm guard fails. Reduced sloped-end applicability, signed oblique row behavior, tool access, splitting, joint strength, and product fit remain open.
The two direct side/leg contact patches intersect the new bore stations and must be regenerated in fresh mechanics preparation; no old contact cells or forces are transferred.
Clearance is nominal CAD occupancy only. It is not physical inspection, purchase verification, drilling release, structural acceptance, or fabrication release.
